name: proposed-isolated-macos-browser-audio-in-bdb47c67
purpose: Approve one diagnostic multi-process run solely to obtain a device ID for testing a page that selects a particular speaker or headset? The page's device listing exits the single-process host during camera enumeration, so the ID must come from a run where it does not, and it is then reused in the single-process experiment.

communication.title: Proposed isolated macOS browser-audio interception proof
